_note: Road encounters (JourneyDirector._road_encounter): now and then, in daylight, someone comes the other way along the road and stops for a word. Rare by design (chance per stretch), never the same person twice in a journey. What they say can be a real clue (knowledge) - which the expedition planner (data/expeditions.json) can turn into the next journey.

pedlar.name: a pedlar
lines: Afternoon, travellers! Bread, cheese, dried apples - road prices, fair prices.
Heading far? Then you'll want more than you think.
mika: We'll take some bread, please. And the apples.
Yes, please. It's a long way still.

rumours.text: They say the old library at the Academy keeps a book about the Wardens, the ones who walked the rings.
The Academy holds open lessons on the east lawn, mornings. Anyone may sit at the back.
Summit-folk swear the Twin Lights stand right over their temple after midnight, in autumn.

pilgrim.name: a pilgrim
lines: Peace on your road. I'm bound for the Cloud Temple.
I'll sit under the Twin Lights, if the weather holds.
mika: The Cloud Temple? On the summit?

rumours.text: There are words carved under the temple's altar, they say. Older than the temple.
The Twin Lights stand over the summit temple just after midnight. Go and see, if you can.

lost.name: a lost traveller
lines: Excuse me - is this the road to the village? I took a wrong turn at the ford.
mika: You're going the right way - keep the stream on your left.
